attributes.name: RPU Type
attributes.description:
Logical grouping/category of RPUs by hardware capability, managed and registered by the RPU Metadata Service. Enumerated values are defined in the API and retrievable via the Swagger `getRpuTypes` endpoint or `GET /v1/rpus?rpuType=<type>`.
  - Example value: `bmw_sil_admake`
  - Specified in job submission payloads via `rpus[].rpuType`
  - Present in `data.available` and `data.deleted` events, indicating the hardware capability category of the associated RPU
  - Dictates required sensor streams and compatible software versions for a given RPU
  - Used as a filter dimension in the RDQ Session Details dashboard to drill down into per-check timelines
  - Used to map repro-relevant DQ checks to specific RPU types via the `rpu_types` parameter in DQ check configuration
  - Surfaced in the UI when configuring a reprocessing candidate run | Enumeration defining the categories/types of RPU available within the RaaS platform.

Discrete unit of KPI computation work executed by the KPI Framework against recorded sessions using a user-supplied configuration file and snapshot version
  - Triggered via REST API (POST /jobs), the KPI trigger tool, the M2M trigger tool, or on a schedule defined by cron expression and date range in the KPI-FW UI

  - Observed failure mode: 79 jobs in the sgtl context fail deterministically with short durations (30–56s), indicating an early crash during execution
